_comment: Operation caps and USD ceilings are Opportunity Radar local guardrails, not provider quotas. The Brave price basis is separately sourced below. Edit freely. Tavily credits remain governed by research-budget.json/research_ledger.py.

estimated_cost_budget_usd.basis: Local ceilings derived from Brave's published $5/1,000-request list price checked 2026-10-23 and its 8/24 operation caps; estimates only, not a bill or provider plan limit. Other provider costs remain unknown and are not converted into USD.

cost_model.basis: official published prepaid Search price and monthly credit checked 2026-10-23; estimate only, account balance/credits may change marginal charge

brave.quota_model: Plan-specific; capture X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset response headers when present. Never substitute example quota values for the account's headers.
brave.retention: Brave API Search Results must not be stored or cached. The wrapper displays links transiently; persist no returned title, URL, snippet or result payload.
brave.query_privacy: Brave states API query records may be retained up to 90 days for billing and troubleshooting; do not send credentials, personal data or confidential research terms.

github.cost_model: unknown; use authenticated or public access actually available

exa.cost_model: unknown; use only when the current session exposes its tools

tavily.cost_model: governed separately in research-budget.json; credits may be estimated or unknown
